set.body:
Problem: the finalizer currently reads unbound .exit/.log files and a benchmark status; historical successful files can be mistaken for results from the current candidate.
Files: tools/ci/first-level-release.sh, tools/ci/finalize_first_level_release.py, their stdlib tests, docs/release-assurance.md.
Steps: at run start write a run manifest with run ID, start time, full git commit, clean flag, build/provider pins, scenario-manifest hash, reference-lock hashes and gate inventory hash. Each completed gate records the same run ID/commit, command, exit code, start/end times and log SHA-256. At finalization require all expected gates once, matching run/commit/input hashes, existing verified logs, and unchanged source commit/clean state. A supplied benchmark receipt must match candidate and workload/source hashes. Keep dirty diagnostic reports explicitly blocked.
Use the structured external evidence contract from P4.4d. Update report version/validation coherently; a current blocked report may validate as a report, but cannot become eligible by dropping failed/missing evidence. Keep generated outputs under target or an external evidence directory so producing reports does not itself dirty candidate sources.
Acceptance: offline tests for stale gate files, mixed run IDs, wrong commit, missing/truncated log, changed inputs, missing gate, skipped/failed gate, wrong-candidate benchmark and clean matching evidence; shell syntax checks. Do not fabricate a passing checked-in report. Final real execution is P4.4j.
set.title: P4.4e: bind local release gate results and benchmark receipts to one candidate
